Package be.imgn.gaia.core.collect

@NullMarked package be.imgn.gaia.core.collect
Collections and collection utilities the JDK does not provide.
  • Class
    Description
    HashListMultimap<K,V>
    A modifiable list multimap backed by a HashMap from each key to a ArrayList of its values.
    HashMultiset<E>
    A modifiable multiset backed by a HashMap, the multiset counterpart of HashSet.
    HashSetMultimap<K,V>
    A modifiable set multimap backed by a HashMap from each key to a HashSet of its values.
    ListMultimap<K,V>
    A multimap that keeps the values of each key in a list, in the order they were added, duplicates included.
    Maps
    Static factories and collectors for unmodifiable maps that iterate in the order their keys are given.
    MoreCollectors
    Collectors that Collectors does not provide.
    MoreGatherers
    Gatherers that Gatherers does not provide.
    MoreGatherers.IndexedFunction<T extends @Nullable Object, R extends @Nullable Object>
    A function of an element and its index in a stream.
    MoreGatherers.IndexedPredicate<T extends @Nullable Object>
    A predicate of an element and its index in a stream.
    Multimap<K,V>
    A collection that maps keys to values, like a Map, but where a key may have several values: its entries are key-value pairs, and a key is in the multimap as long as it has a value.
    Multimaps
    Static factories and collectors for unmodifiable multimaps that iterate over their keys in the order they first appear, and over the values of a key in the order they are given.
    Multiset<E>
    A collection that counts how many times it contains each element: its occurrences.
    Multiset.Entry<E>
    An element of a multiset with its count.
    Multisets
    Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable multisets that iterate in the order their elements first appear, with all occurrences of an element in a row: multiset("foo", "bar", "foo") iterates over foo, foo, bar.
    SetMultimap<K,V>
    A multimap that keeps the values of each key in a set, without duplicates: adding an entry it already contains leaves it unchanged.
    Sets
    Static factories and a collector for unmodifiable sets that iterate in the order their elements are given.
    SortedMultiset<E>
    A multiset that keeps its elements sorted, by their natural ordering or by a comparator: the multiset counterpart of NavigableSet.
    TreeMultiset<E>
    A modifiable sorted multiset backed by a TreeMap, the multiset counterpart of TreeSet.
